_about: Images for the app-simulation prototypes (/prototypes/replay). Generated through api.esy.com from these prompts; files live at public/prototypes/replay/<trade>/<key>.webp. Style matches public/home/svc-*.webp.
style: Stylized 3D render, soft clay-like materials, warm evening lamp light, navy blue and copper color palette, cozy and clean, shallow depth of field, no people's faces, no text, no logos, no watermarks. Landscape 3:2.

roofers.hero: A two-story suburban house at dusk with a freshly installed dark shingle roof, a roofer's ladder leaning on the gutter, warm light glowing from the windows, a work truck parked in the driveway.

services.prompt: A section of roof after a hail storm being repaired: a blue tarp partly rolled back, new shingles stacked beside damaged ones, a roofing hammer and nail pouch resting on the ridge, puddles glinting in lamp light.
A newly installed standing-seam metal roof on a cozy house, clean lines catching warm evening light, a neat stack of leftover panels and a toolbox on the lawn below.
An attic interior with a single drip falling from a roof beam into a copper bucket, a flashlight on the floor lighting new plywood decking and a roll of underlayment.

hvac.hero: The back of a cozy house at dusk with a new outdoor air conditioning condenser on a concrete pad, a technician's tool bag and pressure gauges beside it, warm light in the windows.

services.prompt: An outdoor air conditioning condenser with its service panel open, coiled blue and red refrigerant hoses, a flashlight and screwdrivers laid out on a towel on the grass.
A basement furnace with its front panel removed and a warm blue burner flame visible, a toolbox and a new air filter leaning against it, copper pipes on the wall.
A brand new high-efficiency heat pump indoor unit in a tidy utility room, protective plastic still on the unit, a neat toolbox and a rolled set of plans on a shelf.
